title: Mark the survey’s margin on a monthly chart, and name the changes that pass it.
rule: A survey estimates each month’s change from a sample, so a small change can come from the sample alone. Draw the survey’s margin of error for one month’s change as a band around zero, behind the columns, and give its size, its confidence, such as the Bureau’s 90 percent, and its source in a note (Rule 14.9). Name only the changes that pass it, each with its month and value in the subject ink (Rule 14.6), and print the full count beside them, so a reader still learns how many months fell.

Draw every month in the window the question sets, and print the window’s reason (Rule 14.10). Hatch the months still preliminary, dash the average where it includes one (Rule 14.11), and say in a note that the band measures one month’s change alone. The kit draws the phone drawing, the table and the files (Rules 14.12 to 14.14).

text: A survey of employers estimates each month’s change, and a small drop can come from the sample alone. The band shows a reader that five of the seven drops sit inside the survey’s margin, where the survey cannot tell them apart from no change, and that two pass it, so the chart names those two and still counts all seven.
why.basis: The Bureau of Labor Statistics’ Employment Situation technical note, October 2026 release; Rule 14.9

builders: Draw the band with the kit’s band part from the margin the sidecar’s source line names, name the months with labels.named, and let the kit export the SVG, PNG and CSV, checked row for row against the data file.

specs.label: Window
specs.value: Every month, January 2022 to September 2026, with the reason in a note

specs.label: Margin
specs.value: A band from −122,000 to +122,000 behind the columns, with its edges, in the key and named on the drawing

specs.label: Named drops
specs.value: The two past the margin, in the subject ink, each with its month and value

specs.label: Preliminary
specs.value: Hatched columns, the average dashed where it includes one

specs.label: Files
specs.value: The kit’s SVG, PNG and CSV, the CSV row for row with the data file

correct.caption: The monthly change in payroll jobs, all 57 months, with the survey’s margin as a band, the two drops past it named and the preliminary months hatched. Its phone drawing sits under it, then its table.

failure.caption: Fails Rule 14.142. With no band, all seven drops read as jobs lost, and the title counts seven losses as findings. Five of the seven sit inside the survey’s margin of error.
failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The same columns with no band and the seven drops drawn alike in the strongest ink, under a title that counts seven months of lost jobs.
failure.notes: Labeled failure: a kit figure through s-14-142-failure.chart.json (C7), its title the fault.
